summary: Frontend regression testing for route-based code-splitting (React.lazy + Suspense) in App.js, plus robots.txt/llms.txt SEO fixes. All 16 routes load correctly with no blank pages, no console errors, and no lingering flash-of-nothing. Navbar/Footer navigation, browser back/forward, xoFit tab system + VTO button, and theme toggle all verified working with no regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js code-splitting implementation is clean: Home eager, all other routes lazy, single Suspense fallback={null} wrapping Outlet inside Layout so Navbar/Footer/CookieConsent/Toaster never remount during route transitions.
robots.txt and llms.txt files exist under frontend/public/ with correct content and are served with 200 + text/plain content-type (confirmed via curl), no longer falling back to index.html.

Note (infra-level, not an app bug): Cloudflare injects its own 'Managed content' AI-crawler-blocking block that gets prepended to the served robots.txt response. The app's own file content ('User-agent: * / Allow: /') is still present at the end of the response and correctly served - this is expected CDN behavior, not something to fix in the app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: all routes (/, /xo-vision-care-system, /xoiris-scheduling, /xoexam-eye-exam, /xofit-frame-fitting, /xolab-eyewear-finishing, /about, /team, /news, /blog, /contact, /request-a-demo, /privacy-policy, /terms-and-conditions, /terms-of-service, /this-does-not-exist) load with content and zero console errors under the new lazy-loading setup. Navbar click-through navigation (Home->About->Contact->logo click) works with Navbar always visible. Browser back/forward across Home->About->Blog->back->back lands correctly on Home. xoFit page: fit-tab-core/mobile/frame all visible, clicking frame tab renders vto-trigger-button (no VTO remount regression). Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) works and persists across navigation on About and Blog pages. No further action items - code-splitting change is safe to ship.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this round
